snippet.title: Weight-Loss Injections: How Long to Stop Before Pregnancy? #Shorts
snippet.description:
How long should you stop before a planned pregnancy? According to the official product information: at least two months for semaglutide and at least one month for tirzepatide. Which medication you take, the date of your last dose and when to start trying should be clarified with your prescribing doctor; with diabetes, pregnancy-safe blood sugar treatment should be planned in advance. Dr Senai Aksoy explains.

▶ Full video: https://youtu.be/Q7aCrXhG_E8

On-screen references: EMA, semaglutide (weight management) SmPC § 4.6 · Tirzepatide SmPC (UK) § 4.5–4.6

This content is for information only. It does not replace an individual medical evaluation.
English-dubbed version with an AI voice based on Dr Aksoy's own voice; AI-assisted lip synchronization.
